target_customer: Fintechs, banks, card issuers and B2B payables platforms that want to convert ACH and check payments into card payments
problem: Many suppliers accept cards but payments run through manual portals or are assumed to carry surcharges, so card revenue is missed; Sunlight's agents detect acceptance and execute card payments in supplier portals.
business_model: API / usage-based infrastructure sold to B2B payment platforms (agentic portal payments, card-on-file updates)
product_category: B2B payments infrastructure (AI agents for card payments)

founders.name: Guy Ziv
founders.background_notes: YC bio: business executive and entrepreneur who brought new technologies to financial institutions; experience in product delivery, sales strategy and partnerships.

founders.name: Leo Chanea
founders.background_notes: YC bio: product executive and community expert.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable automation across many supplier portals and card-on-file updates is standard engineering with hard parts (portal variance, payment controls); the CEO says controls to avoid paying the wrong bill were a key milestone.

defensibility.rationale: No documented moat; acceptance data by buyer and supplier could compound, but the sources do not show it yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sources describe incumbent responses. The site lists fintech clients such as Ramp, Bill, Brex, Tipalti and Melio as customers, so payables platforms appear to be buyers rather than copiers.

market_need_then: Card-on-file updates and B2B card acceptance were described by the company as missed revenue for card issuers and payables platforms; no dated 2021-2022 evidence of demand was found beyond the YC listing.

branding.domain_note: Uses sunlightapi.com; the exact sunlight.com name is not used.

identity.visual_style: Sun emoji styling in its YC launch material
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, enterprise-focused benefit copy ('More Card Revenue. No Manual Work.')

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; search results mix Sunlight with unrelated companies (Sunlight Financial, Sunlight Payments).

pivots.from: Card-on-file API to change the card on file with apps and subscription services (early YC listing)
pivots.to: Agentic AI execution layer for B2B card payments in supplier portals
pivots.why: Not stated; timing unknown, current positioning shown in a July 2026 PYMNTS interview

outcome_analysis: Sunlight is a six-person Summer 2022 company that began as a card-on-file API and now sells AI agents that execute B2B card payments in supplier portals, with fintech customer logos on its site. No funding round, revenue or customer count has been confirmed, and aggregator data shows only a $500K convertible note. It is too early and too opaque to call an outcome, so no success or failure factors are asserted.
notes: CB Insights lists a $500K convertible note (single aggregator, undated here) and Bouncewatch a September 2022 undisclosed pre-seed; neither is recorded as a round, hence none_found. YC launch post thanks a third founder named Gil; no full name found. Searches for dated 2022 competitors returned nothing reliable; the aggregator competitor lists were ignored. Pivot date unknown. Web Archive skipped. Completeness pass: recorded a pre-seed in September 2022 (Bouncewatch dates it 2022-09-12, CB Insights lists a convertible note on 2022-09-07). Amount null; CB Insights gives 500K total raised. A third founder named Gil Peretz appears only on a reconstructed Round Funded page, so not added.
